name: labs/openuc2__imswitch
title: OpenUC2 ESP32 microscope stage
intro: OpenUC2 ESP32 microscope stage, adapted from openuc2/imswitch. It reads `x_um`, `y_um` and `z_um`; runs `move_xyz` and `stop_motion`. `move_xyz`: move the X, Y and Z stage axes to absolute positions in micrometres with the coordinated upstream XYZ move, and report the position a device query returns afterwards; a move whose native call raises or whose position query fails ends unknown. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/openuc2__imswitch --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/openuc2__imswitch --backend fake --mcp
